title: yummy turkish walnuts toast
description: a fermented, crunchy turkish dish featuring cinnamon stick, perfect for any time of day, especially as a snack or as a side dish

ingredients.name: chia seeds
ingredients.notes: soaked overnight in water (250ml) and drained before use

instructions: preheat oven to 2009c (4009f) for toasting bread.
soak chia seeds in 250ml water overnight and drain before use.
toast bread cubes in the oven for 5-7 minutes or until lightly browned.
mix walnuts, chia seeds, and cinnamon sticks in a large bowl.
squeeze in lemon juice and mix well.
add honey and mix until well combined.
place toasted bread cubes in a serving dish and spoon walnut mixture over the top.
drizzle with remaining lemon juice if desired
